title: Real-data Grunfeld estimate-table renderer benchmark
p_value: artifact-construction adapter: two-sided finite-df Student-t p from t = coef/se with residual df = reghdfe e(df_r)=9 (deterministic; NOT new estimator evidence, NOT renderer logic)
ci: artifact-construction adapter: coef +/- qt(0.975, df)*se (deterministic; required by estimates contract)
scope: Estimate-table rendering from estimates (explicit estimate_id; fixed fields term/estimate/std_error/p_value/n) is the primary scope. The same non-synthetic Grunfeld bundle additionally exercises deterministic derived-view tables for descriptive_facts (sample_size/firms), diagnostics (cluster_count/residual_df), and model_registry (MODEL_GRUNFELD spec) with full artifact/provenance validation, source fidelity, determinism, and fail-closed provenance enforcement.

family_promotion: presentation.local.descriptive_table_renderer / presentation.local.diagnostics_table_renderer / presentation.local.model_table_renderer promoted to tested for their respective family scope only (upon synthetic + genuine non-synthetic Grunfeld evidence); NOT verified, NOT generic tables, NOT figures.
